## Findings: English Title Styling Patterns

I've analyzed both the **About page** (`views/pages/about/index.php`) and **Main page** (`views/pages/index.php`), plus the SCSS styling system. Here are the exact class patterns used for English headings:

### **Font Weight Utility Classes** (from `resource/scss/base/_utils.scss`, lines 368-379):

```scss
.--regular  { font-weight: 400; }
.--medium   { font-weight: 500; }
.--semibold { font-weight: 600; }
.--bold     { font-weight: 700; }
```

### **Font Family Utility Classes** (from `resource/scss/base/_utils.scss`, lines 356-367):

```scss
.--fm-en        { font-family: var(--family-en-base); }
.--fm-en-title  { font-family: var(--family-en-title); }
.--fm-ko        { font-family: var(--family-ko-base); }
.--fm-ui        { font-family: var(--family-ui); }
```

---

## **ABOUT PAGE English Title Patterns**

**File:** `views/pages/about/index.php`

| Section | Heading | Class Structure | Notes |
|---------|---------|-----------------|-------|
| **Hero Intro** | "We Are" + "Explorers" | `f-display-x --fm-en` + `f-display-x --fm-en --medium` | Two-line heading; second line is medium weight |
| **Hero Intro** | "Digital Web Agency" | `f-heading-2 --regular --fm-ui` | UI font, regular weight |
| **Hero Slogan** | "We Lead Your (Design, Development, Branding, UI/UX) Journey" | `f-display-x --fm-en` with nested `--regular` span | Complex nested: outer has no explicit weight modifier, inner `--regular` on specific words |
| **Who Section** | "We Build the Route" (decorative layers) | `f-display-x --fm-en --regular` | Regular weight display font |
| **Vision** | "Our Vision Is to Turn Bold Brands into Living Digital Journeys." | `f-display-1 --fm-en --regular mask-target` | Large display font, regular weight |
| **Mission Title** | "Mission" | `f-display-1 --fm-en --regular mask-target` | Display level 1, regular weight |
| **Mission Cards** | "Uncharted", "Proof", "Launch" | `f-heading-1 mask-target` (no font family class) | No explicit font-family modifier (inherits from parent context) |
| **Services Title** | "Services" (small header) | `--fm-en-title f-heading-4 --regular mask-target` | Heading level 4, regular weight, en-title font |
| **Services Description** | "Every Build Your Brand Needs, Handled By One **Crew.** From Direction To Launch." | `f-display-1 --medium --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1, medium weight, en-title font |
| **Service Items** | "Web Build", "App Build", "Branding", etc. | `f-display-1 --fm-en-title --regular mask-target` | Display 1, regular weight, en-title font |
| **Awards** | "Awards" | `f-display-1 --fm-en --regular mask-target` | Display 1, regular weight, base en font |
| **Partners** | "Partners" | `f-display-1 --fm-en --regular mask-target` | Display 1, regular weight |
| **Contact** | "Your Journey Starts Here." | `f-display-0 --regular --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 0 (largest), regular weight, en-title font |

---

## **MAIN PAGE English Title Patterns**

**File:** `views/pages/index.php`

| Section | Heading | Class Structure | Notes |
|---------|---------|-----------------|-------|
| **Intro** | "YOUR BRAND HAS ONE FIRST SCREEN." | `f-display-x --semibold --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display X, **semibold** weight (600), en-title font |
| **Intro Hook** | "IT SHOULD PROVE SOMETHING." | `f-heading-4 --regular --fm-ui` | Heading 4, regular, UI font (not English-specific) |
| **Intro Action 1** | "WE START BESIDE YOU." | `f-display-1 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1, no weight modifier (inherits default 600 from display) |
| **Intro Action 2** | "READY TO LAUNCH." | `f-display-1 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1, same pattern |
| **Hero Slogan** | "JOIN THE JOURNEY" | `f-display-0 --fm-en-title no-main-hero__reveal mask-target` | Display 0, no weight override (inherits 600), en-title font |
| **Story Title 1** | "WHY WE BUILD THIS WAY." | `f-display-1 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1, no weight override |
| **Story Title 2** | "A NEW BRAND NEEDS AN UNCHARTED WEB." | `f-heading-4 --fm-en-title --regular mask-target` | Heading 4, regular (400), en-title font |
| **Story Large** | "DEFAULT IS SAFE. UNCHARTED IS WHERE BRANDS BEGIN." | `f-display-2 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 2, no weight override (inherits 600) |
| **Who Section** | "YOUR BRAND LEADS. WE BUILD THE ROUTE." | `f-display-1 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1, no weight override |
| **Why Skills** | "THREE.JS", "GSAP", "WEBFLOW", etc. | `f-display-0 --semibold --fm-en-title` | Display 0, **semibold** weight, en-title font |
| **Services Title** | "SERVICES" | `--fm-en-title f-display-0 mask-target` | Display 0, no weight override (inherits 600), en-title font |
| **Portfolio Head 1** | "FROM PLAN TO SCREEN" | `f-display-1_5 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1.5 (intermediate), no weight override |
| **Portfolio Head 2** | "WORK BECOMES REAL" | `f-display-1_5 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1.5, same pattern |
| **Clients** | "PARTNERS" | `f-display-1 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 1, no weight override |
| **Contact** | "YOUR JOURNEY STARTS HERE." | `f-display-0 --fm-en-title mask-target` | Display 0, no weight override (inherits 600) |

---

## **Key Styling Observations**

### Font Family Patterns:
- **`--fm-en-title`** = Used for major headings/section titles (especially all-caps, large display fonts)
- **`--fm-en`** = Used for smaller English text or mixed content (like about page mission descriptions)
- **`--fm-ui`** = Used for non-section headings (like "Digital Web Agency", "IT SHOULD PROVE SOMETHING")

### Font Weight Patterns:
- **`--regular` (400)**: About page uses this heavily on English headings; Main page uses it selectively
- **`--medium` (500)**: Rare; only used in About page service description and Main page intro action body
- **`--semibold` (600)**: Main page uses this explicitly on top-level headings (intro, why skills) — About page mostly relies on inherited defaults
- **`--bold` (700)**: Not used on English section headings

### Weight Inheritance Default:
- `f-display-*` classes have `fw: 600` (semibold) as their baseline (from `_headings.scss`, lines 11-48)
- `f-heading-*` classes have `fw: 600` as their baseline too (lines 49-90)
- So **when no weight modifier is applied, display/heading inherits 600 (semibold)**

### About vs Main Page Differences:
1. **About page** explicitly marks English headings with `--regular` (400) much more frequently
2. **Main page** relies on defaults (600/semibold) for most headings, only explicitly adding `--semibold` for selected top-level titles like intro and skills
3. About page uses both `--fm-en` and `--fm-en-title` interchangeably
4. Main page prefers `--fm-en-title` for nearly all English headings (except hook text)

---

## **SCSS Files Structure**

- **Typography definition**: `resource/scss/abstract/_headings.scss` (defines fluid display/heading/body scales)
- **Utility classes**: `resource/scss/base/_utils.scss` (defines `--regular`, `--semibold`, `--fm-en-title`, etc.)
- **Main page styles**: `resource/scss/pages/_main.scss`
- **Sub/About page styles**: `resource/scss/pages/_sub.scss`
